purpose: Teach: オシャレ/かまい/壊す/重宝/裕福/ばらばら/図鑑/妖怪

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、今日、オシャレな格好だね、新しい服?
lines.en: Riku — you're looking pretty sharp today. New clothes?
lines.style: Teasing observation, quick rhythm. Casual lean-in with a hint of curiosity underneath the surface brightness. Light, playful, but watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前が、ちょっと遅れても、俺は、かまいませんよ、桜、待ってる。
lines.en: Yeah. And honestly, it doesn't matter if you're a little late. I'll wait for you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter than her energy. Sincere, slightly vulnerable. Eyes soften on 「かまいません」. Spoken like he's been holding onto this, letting it out carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部室のドア、壊すなって、先輩、注意してたよね、皆。
lines.en: The senpai was super clear about not breaking the clubroom door, remember? Everyone heard it.
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-smile in the voice. Eyebrow implied. She's catching him in something and doesn't mind being the one to say it. Light jab wrapped in sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの工具、結構、重宝してるんだぜ、俺、DIYで。
lines.en: Actually, my dad's tools have been pretty handy for DIY stuff.
lines.style: Shifts tone — brighter, almost defensive-cheerful. Picks up pace slightly. Trying to move past her jab by pivoting to something he genuinely likes talking about.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスの中で、裕福な家庭の子、結構いるよね、よく考えると。
lines.en: Now that I think about it, there are quite a few kids in our class from pretty well-off families.
lines.style: Slower, more thoughtful. She's turning something over in her head. Not accusatory — genuinely observing. Quiet fascination with the pattern she's just noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験、終わったら、ばらばらに、遊びに行くの、皆と、楽しいよな。
lines.en: After exams we all scatter and go do our own things, but it's nice, you know? Being part of that.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, a little wistful nostalgia layered under present happiness. Slower pace on the middle phrase. He's feeling it — the group, the moment, that it won't last forever.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 子供の頃の図鑑、まだ、実家に、置いてあるよ、私、大事にしてる。
lines.en: I still have the encyclopedias from when I was a kid at my parents' house. I take good care of them.
lines.style: Tender, private admission. Voice softens and becomes almost whispered on the confession. She's letting him see something small and true about herself. No performance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 妖怪映画、最近、流行ってるよな、お前、見た、桜?
lines.en: Those yokai movies are huge right now. Have you seen any of them, Sakura?
lines.style: Leaning toward her slightly. Conversational, genuine interest in what she thinks. Warm curiosity, not just making talk. Testing the waters for more of this moment together.
